item.title: Hugo RSS and Atom Feeds
item.description: RSS and Atom are still how a lot of readers and tools discover new posts. Hugo can emit both from the same content tree. On DevOpsTales the site ships classic RSS plus Atom via the hugo-atom-feed component theme, with a custom Atom template that skips the filedir partial section.
